fieldMarks: Greyish-brown back with an off-white cream belly
Loose gliding membrane bordered by black hair from wrist to ankle
Large eyes and pink hairless inner ears; 38-90 g, 200-285 mm
Smaller than the northern flying squirrel
behavior: Strictly nocturnal, active year-round except in extreme cold
Highly social; up to 20 nest together in winter
Glides up to about 28 m between trees
Omnivorous: insects, nuts, bird eggs, berries, seeds; caches food; calls include arc-whistles, trills and ultrasonic sounds
habitat: Deciduous and mixed temperate forest (beech-maple, oak-hickory, poplar). Nests in tree cavities, old woodpecker holes or leaf nests, often within 100 m of water.
range: Eastern North America from Quebec south through the eastern United States (source gives Quebec to Honduras overall).

lookalikes.name: Northern flying squirrel
lookalikes.howToTell: Larger, with grey-based belly hairs rather than cream.
